run_gpu_py.batching: none: predict() (scripts/run_gpu.py:73-110) tokenises one prompt, pops attention_mask (l.81), appends EMPTY_TOKEN_ID, and calls vla.generate on a batch of 1 (l.88-89); items are sharded across GPUs by index modulo nshards (l.134), each GPU running batch 1
run_gpu_py.decoding: greedy, 7 tokens, output_scores; dy scores are conditioned on the greedy dx token
run_gpu_py.logged_per_dimension: a (argmax action), b (argmax bin), c (EV, 31744 omitted), cf (EV, 31744 folded), p (top prob, 255-token slice), h (entropy, 255-token slice), m (mass on 256 action tokens); the 7x256 probabilities exist in memory (l.103) but are not saved
